description: This file contains utility functions for cleaning up and removing directories and paths related to the OpenClaw project, including path validation, collection of workspace directories, and removal operations with safety checks.

methods.name: collectWorkspaceDirs
methods.description: Collects workspace directories from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: buildCleanupPlan
methods.description: Builds a cleanup plan indicating which paths are inside the state directory.

methods.name: isPathWithin
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within a parent directory.

methods.name: isUnsafeRemovalTarget
methods.description: Determines if a target path is unsafe to remove (e.g., root or home directory).

methods.name: removePath
methods.description: Removes a specified path if it is safe, with support for dry run and error handling.

methods.name: removeStateAndLinkedPaths
methods.description: Removes the state directory and linked paths, respecting whether they are inside the state directory.

methods.name: listAgentSessionDirs
methods.description: Lists session directories for agents within the specified state directory.
